rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Contributes the AVT, an original vulnerability taxonomy for agentic coding systems.
rationale.ai-review: UAST architecture uses an LLM auditor and LLM-assisted semantic analysis.
rationale.rules-based-checks: UAST includes dynamic analysis by executing dependencies in isolated sandboxes.
rationale.provenance-auditability: PCV layer verifies code provenance and reasoning traces for human forensics.
rationale.org-governance: CGI layer integrates risk signals into organizational GRC platforms and dashboards.
rationale.metrics: ARSM defines an organizational risk metric for security in agentic pipelines.
